title: ParsedProfile
description: The structured representation of a Kindling profile, produced by parsing a freeform profile URL (with h-card baseline plus AI extraction).

schema_version.description: The version of the parsed_profile schema this document conforms to.

profile_url.description: Canonical source URL the profile was parsed from.

display_name.description: Human-readable name as the owner presents themselves.

location.description: Where the owner lives or operates from. All fields optional.

remote.description: True if the owner explicitly identifies as remote / location-independent.

photo_hints.description: URLs to images on the source page. Kindling does not cache; implementations decide whether to cache locally.

intent_tags.description: What the owner is open to (friendship, dating, networking, hiking buddies, co-founders, etc.).

about.description: Free-text 'about me' compressed from the source page. Plain text only at v0.1.

verification.description: Identity verification level for this profile.

level.description: The strongest verification this profile holds. 'cryptographic' is reserved for v0.2.

verifier.description: For OAuth: the provider (google, apple, etc.). For curator-vouched: the curator's identity.

messaging_preferences.description: Per-profile rules for incoming messages and handshakes.

kindling_noindex.description: If true, this profile asks not to be included in any Pool. Compliant Pools and crawlers respect this.

parsed_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of when this parsed_profile was produced.

parser.description: Identifier of the parser implementation that produced this profile (e.g., 'kindling-parser/0.1.0').
